teaser: Show someone five versions of their own website without publishing anything: sealed in a vault, opened with a QR code, a link or a zip.
core_idea: A demo of someone's own website cannot be public, so the demo cell seals five designs in an encrypted sgit vault, which a drop page opens in the browser from a QR code, a link or a zip, and the same vault becomes their sovereign website if they say yes.

nodes.label: Demo to site
nodes.summary: The same vault becomes the site.

quotes.text: A person who has not yet agreed to anything should not find a version of themselves on the open web.
All I am doing is selling.
